subject: OpenAir Labs — temporary headroom / safety valve request
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya@openairlabs.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@openairlabs.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Temporary headroom for Black Friday window

Hi David,

We pushed a product update to a subset of users and traffic spiked unexpectedly. We're already over our quota and seeing throttles in the evaluation environment. Can Redwood temporarily lift our concurrency and token quotas for the week of Nov 27–Dec 3?

We want to avoid dropping requests; this is only for a short window while we scale autoscaling rules. OpenAir is fine with a one-time uplift fee or blended overage rate — we just need a fast path + PO.

Can you outline what you can do (rate, cap, confirmation timeline)? Procurement is ready to sign a PO if terms look reasonable.

Thanks,
Maya
Maya Patel
Head of Platform
OpenAir Labs

--
Attachment: error_log_snippet.txt (text)

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <maya@openairlabs.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Temporary headroom for Black Friday window

Hi Maya — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the launch.

We can offer a short-term safety valve for Nov 27–Dec 3 with the following options:

1) Emergency uplift (fastest) — +3x token concurrency for the window, capped at 1.5M extra tokens total. Rate: blended overrun at $0.012/token above your committed tier. Requires signed one-page PO. We can turn this on within 6 hours of PO confirmation.

2) Headroom credit bundle — prepaid buffer of 500k tokens at a discounted overrun rate of $0.009/token, usable only during the date window. Legal needs a short amendment; procurement PO ok. Activation 24 hours after PO.

3) Soft-commit temporary bump — temporary increase to next commit tier for the month (prorated), with automatic true-up to your next invoice. This requires a short amendment and takes 48–72 hours to complete.

We recommend option 1 given your timeline. Attached is a draft PO and a quick pricing matrix. If procurement can return the signed PO today we’ll queue the uplift.

Quick Qs for our side: do you want a hard cap (stop at cap) or graceful degrade once the cap hits? Also, do you need the uplift applied to both inference and embedding routes?

I’ve looped in Laura (AM) and Ben (Finance) to confirm PO flow and discount levers.

—David
David Kim
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: headroom_pricing_matrix.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: OpenAir PO and discount request

David / Ben — quick internal note before I reply to Maya:

- If we push option 1 as the default, finance is ok with offering a 10% one-time uplift discount (off the overrun rate) for strategic customers. Ben — can we stretch to 12% if procurement attaches a 6-month committed top-up after the event?
- Legal prefers the PO to reference our standard short-term uplift addendum (I linked the doc).
- Ops needs a hard cap toggle; they can implement both stop-at-cap and graceful-degrade but need the cap value before enabling.

Suggested reply to customer: confirm option 1 with a 10% uplift discount, hard cap at 1.5M extra tokens, activation within 6 hours of receiving signed PO (we'll provide a sandbox toggle and confirmation email). Ask procurement to send PO + billing contact and indicate whether they want the uplift applied to embeddings as well.

I'll also propose the 6-month follow-on commitment incentive in the same email as a follow-through to Andrew in procurement.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Maya — following up with concrete next steps.

We’ll proceed with Option 1 (Emergency uplift) and apply a one-time 10% discount on the overrun rate. Summary:
- Window: 2026-11-27 00:00 UTC through 2026-12-03 23:59 UTC
- Uplift: +3x concurrency and up to 1,500,000 additional tokens for the window
- Rate (post-discount): $0.0108 per overrun token (was $0.012)
- Cap behavior: hard stop at the cap; we will enable graceful-degrade only if you request it in the PO.
- Activation: within 6 hours of receiving a signed PO (signed copy to procurement@redwood.ai).

Attached is the one-page PO draft (named OpenAir_PO_Draft.pdf). If you sign and return, we’ll confirm by email and schedule the toggle. For procurement: please include billing contact and indicate if embeddings should be included; otherwise this uplifts inference routes only.

If you opt to convert the uplift into a 6-month committed increase afterward we can apply an additional 12% credit against MRR for the first two months — we'll include those terms in the amendment.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-min call if you want to walk through the flow.

Best,
David

Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
